# Ember Lifecycle Comment Templates

These are Ember-defined comment contracts. Select the precise lifecycle
transition; do not post generic status prose. Every comment states disposition,
the exact missing or changed condition, responsible actor or dependency,
reactivation/removal condition, and whether it authorizes any action.

Duplicate-candidate comments never claim equivalence. Supersession transfers
clauses explicitly. Stale disposition may fold, park, or surface work but never
closes, kills, or erases it automatically.
